caseName: What Is the Maid of Honor Hiding Ten Days Before the Wedding?
title: Lucia & Bex

questions.text:
Okay. I'm doing this. My hands are shaking 😔
Bex was at my place last night helping me fold place cards. She left early, said she was wiped.
She's never wiped. She closes down every party we've ever been to.
Who did she call after she left?

Him?? That's my fiancé 😳
Three nights ago he told me he was working late. That same night Bex bailed on wine with me, some excuse about work.
I don't want to think what I'm thinking.
Where exactly did the two of them meet that night?

That's a cocktail bar. Dim lights, tiny tables. He's never once taken me there.
And it gets worse. Colm says one of our vendors put our order on hold, and he won't tell me which one. I didn't do it.
Which vendor did she contact behind my back?
questions.hint: Look through her Mail, including what she sent.

questions.text:
Of course it's the biggest bill of the whole wedding 😤
I don't get it. Bex is broke right now. She's been skipping lunches to save money, I've watched her do it.
I need to know where her money is actually going.
Who got her biggest single payment over the past 30 days?

I had to look that up. It's a courthouse office three states away.
Bex has lived in Asheville her whole adult life. No family out there, no cases out there, no reason at all to call them.
What was she looking for there?

Why would she want those?
Wait. Colm lived out there for years before we met. He never talks about it, just calls it a boring chapter.
My stomach just dropped 😳
Whose name did she find next to his?

onboarding.text: I'm Lucia. I run a flower shop, and in ten days I'm getting married. I should be glowing. Instead I'm hiding in a bridal boutique bathroom, holding a phone that isn't mine.
onboarding.label: Lucia

onboarding.text: Bex and I met freshman year, fighting over the last dryer in the dorm. Thirteen years later she's my maid of honor. She's the one who talked me into opening the shop.
onboarding.label: Lucia & Rebecca

onboarding.text: Rebecca Holloway. Bex. She's a paralegal, so she notices everything and says about half of it. Lately she takes calls outside, cancels on me, and vanished for two days with no real explanation.
onboarding.label: Rebecca

onboarding.text: She's in the fitting room right now, and her phone was in my bag. I have maybe twenty minutes. I'll ask, you look. Please, just tell me I'm being paranoid.
onboarding.label: Lucia

msgs.text: Lantern Hall just confirmed us for August 16!! 🎉🎉
SHUT UP. I'm screaming. Hartwell next?
Hartwell for the tent, then the cake tasting. I made a spreadsheet. Don't laugh.
Never. Send it, I'll make my own copy with colors.
At the flower market. Peonies are insane this year. Do you want 40 photos or 4?
Four. I'm in a deposition prep fog, give me peonies.
🌸🌸🌸🌸 okay. Also you're giving a speech and you're not allowed to say no
I've been drafting since the day you got engaged. It's on v3 already.
Marigold tasting went SO well. Lemon cake with the olive oil thing. You would have cried.
I hate that I missed it. Save me a slice?
I took the whole box home. It's in my fridge. Come get it.
Final dress fitting is August 6 at 9:30, Belle Laurel. Put it in your calendar, you're coming. No excuses.
Already in. With an alarm. And a backup alarm.
Shop was slammed today. Three sympathy arrangements and a quinceañera. My feet are dead 😩
Sit. Eat something that isn't a granola bar. I'm sending good energy and zero advice.
Two years of shop savings in that fund and Colm just tells me the total, I don't even look anymore.
Which is sweet that you trust him. Maybe look once in a while, that's all. It's a lot of money.
I know, I know. Paranoid. He's good with numbers, I'm good with peonies. That's the deal 😂
Can you cover your half of the bachelorette deposit by the end of the week? No stress if not.
Two payments behind on the car.
Payday's soon. I'll get the deposit to you then, I promise.
Bex, forget it, I'll float it. Pay me back whenever ❤️
Thank you. I mean it.
Place card font debate. Script or serif??
Serif. Script is unreadable by candlelight and you know it.
License application DONE!! Sat right next to him while he filled out his half 😭 copy's on my fridge.
Look at you two. Proud of you.
Work trip, out-of-town depo. Back in two days, signal will be trash.
Ugh, now?? Ten days before the wedding?? Okay. Safe travels 😩
Hey, you alive? Seating chart question, call me when you can
Barely. Depo ran long. Talk when I'm back.
You're back?? I have so much to tell you. Table 7 is a disaster.
Back. Sorry for the silence. Table 7 sounds like a Dale-and-his-wife problem.
Thanks for coming by this afternoon. You were so quiet though, everything okay?
Just tired. Depo hangover. Go to bed, bride.
Colm says one of our vendors has us ON HOLD and he won't tell me which, says he's handling it. I didn't do that!! Did you hear anything?
Weird. Let me look into it.
You're the best. I'm trying not to spiral. There's an explanation, right?
Still coming tonight? I'm ordering Rosa's. Place cards won't fold themselves 🍕
Yes. Bringing the good scissors.
I'm wiped, heading home. Love you.
Love you more. Text me when you're home 🌸
Home. Docket is judging me from the couch.
Fitting tomorrow!! Don't be late, I'm bringing coffee ☕
Bex, I need a favor. I want to learn a first dance before the wedding. My feet are cement.
Ha. Okay. I know a studio that does one-off lessons. Don't tell L., she'll want to watch.
Deal. You're the best maid of honor a guy could ask for.
Song?
Something slow. Her grandmother's favorite. I'll text you the title.
Found the exact edition of her grandmother's cookbook. Used bookshop in Charlotte. Surprise for the rehearsal dinner.
She is going to lose it. In a good way. Hide it somewhere she'll never look.
Hiding it behind the HVAC manuals in the truck. She'd never.
Studio lesson booked for the 28th of June, 6 PM. Wear shoes you can slide in.
On it. Wish me luck.
Lesson went fine. Stepped on her only once.
I heard the instructor's review. 'Enthusiastic.' 😂
Colm, quick one. I was helping Lucia tidy the wedding budget and the numbers don't add up. Paid in vs what's left. Can you send me the fund statement?
Sure. I'll forward it tonight. Probably just a timing thing.
Thanks. Tonight is fine.
Sent. It's all there.
Got it. Thank you.
We need to talk. Alone. Not at your place.
What's this about?
You know exactly what it's about.
Call me.
Calling you now.
Hollow Oak at 7. Please. Don't tell anyone.
I'll be there. I'm not doing this over text.
Name a number. I'll send you $5,000 tonight and this stays between us until after the wedding. I'm sorting it out, I swear.
Don't send me anything.
It's in your PayPal. Please just think about it.
Check your PayPal. I'm not for sale.
Bex. Come on. I'm trying to fix this.
Then fix it. Tell her.
I will. I just need time. I'm getting it sorted, I promise.
I met your son.
You had no right to go near Declan. He's six. He has nothing to do with this.
I didn't go near him. I talked to his mother, that's all. He's the only one in this who's done nothing wrong.
I can't believe you.
7:30 tonight. Be on time.
I'll be there.
Give me a week. One week. Please.
Okay. Until after the honeymoon. That's all I'm asking.
No.
48 hours. That's what you get to tell her yourself. Then she hears it from me.
Please. Bex.
Run on the greenway tomorrow? 6:30, before it gets gross out
6:30 is a war crime but yes
I'll bring coffee. Switchback oat latte, right?
You're a saint. Meet at the footbridge
I'm here, where are you
Parking. Two minutes. Docket was sitting on my shoes
Excuses 😂
That was 4 miles and I'm still alive. Proud of us.
Pace was 10:12, we're basically elite
Okay shower gift. I priced the linen set plus the cheese board. Total's $168. Split four ways?
Works. Send me the PayPal request and I'll pay it
Sent. $42 each
Paid. Next paycheck I'll cover the card too
Have you started the new book club pick? I'm 40 pages in and I already suspect the husband
It's always the husband. Or the sister who 'found' the body
Don't spoil it!!
I'm 15 pages in, I don't know anything. Pure vibes.
Book club is at mine next time btw. I'm making the cold noodle thing.
I'll bring wine and a very low bar for dessert
Brunch spot booked for 8 people at 11:00. Can you confirm who's coming?
Me, you, Lucia, and I'm still waiting on a couple of the others
Did you hear that new episode of the one about the cold case in Tennessee? The ending 😳
Not yet, I'm saving it for my long drive. No spoilers!!
Okay okay. Zipped.
Heads up the river's low, so the tubing thing might be cancelled
Fine by me. I get sunburned in the shade.
You and your tiny freckle army 😂
They're a collective. They have a union.
The string trio sent a playlist for the ceremony options. Did you listen?
Listening on my run tomorrow. I like the second one
Can I borrow your foam roller? Mine is basically a pancake now
Yes, it's in the hall closet. Come get it whenever, the door's got the sticky lock so just jiggle it
Got it. Your hall closet is organized like an evidence room.
Labeled bins are a lifestyle
Stressed about the dress alterations. Mine's too tight, apparently I've been eating cheese
Cheese is a food group. Fittings will fix it
Thinking tacos tonight? Rosa's has the deal on
Rosa's is pizza. Do you mean the truck behind the brewery?
Yes the truck!! Brain is fried
I can do 7. I need to be home by 9 for laundry
Grown-up problems. See you at 7
Bex you okay? You were kind of quiet at dinner
Just tired. Long week of filings. I'm okay, promise.
Okay. Text me if you want to vent. Or run.
Are you free for a catch-up this week? I miss your face
I miss yours too. Work + wedding stuff is eating me alive
Wedding stuff for Lucia? How's she holding up?
Full planning mode. Spreadsheets for the spreadsheets
Ha. You're a good friend
Trying. Coffee after the wedding, I promise
You ok? Haven't heard from you
Sorry, work travel and zero signal. Back now. Fill me in on anything I missed
Just saw your Instagram story. The river looks gorgeous
Early morning run. Best part of my day
I'm jealous. I'm stuck at my desk
Take a walk at lunch. Doctor's orders
Your orders, not a doctor's 😂
I found your sunglasses in my car
Oh thank god, I thought I lost them at the river
Want them back?
Please. I'll swing by
I'm home all evening
Okay, around 7 maybe
I'm making pizza from scratch, don't judge the crust
I never judge
You always judge
I judge gently
lol come hungry
On my way
Run. Definitely run. Maybe tomorrow if it's cool.
Heard Docket ate a hair tie again?
I'm in. Same bridge, same pain.
Who told you?? Nell?
Nell told me. Is she ok
She's fine, she's judging me from the couch
Hi honey its Dad. Mom showed me how to text. Call me when u get a chance
Hi Dad! Calling in 5
OK
Thanks for calling. Tell Docket hello.
She says meow, in a hostile way
Ha. Good girl.
Check your oil before you drive down here. Car has been running rough?
Weather says storms this weekend. Don't drive that stretch of 40 after dark okay
I won't. I'm staying put and doing laundry like an adult
It's been fine Dad, just an old car. Pete's looking at it this week.
Pete is good. Dont let him upsell you on the fancy filter.
I won't. I have your voice in my head.
Good.
Caught a bass this morning. 3 pounds. Sending a photo when I figure out how.
Nice!! Three pounds is a real fish
Your mother says it is a small fish. She is wrong.
I'm on your side
Thats my girl
Saw a Mazda on the lot at Hendricks like yours. They wanted way too much. Yours is a good car, keep it running
That's the plan Dad 😅
Storm coming through tonight. Make sure your windows are shut.
They are. Thanks Dad. You're the weather channel.
Just looking out. Love you
Love you too
Panthers preseason schedule is out. You and me, one game, my treat
I'm in. Check that Mom doesn't have us at her sister's that weekend
Good point. Will clear it
The porch swing is fixed. I did it myself.
Imogen told me. I hear there were four tools involved.
Five. Dont tell your mother about the drill.
Secret's safe 🤐
Finally fixed the gutter. Only fell off the ladder once. Kidding. Don't tell your mother I said that
DAD. Please use the ladder stabilizer I got you
Using it. Mostly.
Are you coming down soon? Your room is still your room.
Soon, I promise. Work is wild and there's a lot going on. I'll call you Sunday.
No rush. Just checking in.
Proud of you kiddo. Mom says you've been working too hard. Eat something real tonight
Eating dinner now, promise ❤️
Eat something green this week.
Dad. I'm 31.
Still.
Porch swing update: chains were on backwards
Dad.
It's fine, I flipped them
Is it holding weight?
Your mother sat on it. It held
She says it's crooked
Is it crooked?
It's rustic. Love you kiddo
Hi it's Brianna! Lucia gave me your number for the shower planning
Hi!! Yes, I've been meaning to text you. Co-captains?
Co-captains. I made a spreadsheet, don't judge
I would never. I'm a paralegal, spreadsheets are my love language
Okay good. Budget idea: $40 each for decor and food
Works. I can do $40
Venue idea: my sister's backyard, she has a pergola
Perfect, Lucia would love a garden thing
Small is the vibe. 15 people tops
Invites go out this week. Text or paper?
Paper. She keeps cards. Her mom has a shoebox of every card she's ever gotten
Cute. Paper it is. Ordering from the stationery shop on Lexington
I'll pick up the stamps
You're a gem
Look, I'm moving apartments in 3 weeks. Do you have boxes?
I have like 8 flattened ones in my closet. Take them
RSVP count: 11 yes, 2 maybe, 1 'my cat has surgery'
Poor cat. So 13ish then
Food: finger sandwiches, lemon bars, a mimosa bar
Add a non-alcoholic option for the cousin who's pregnant
Already on it. Sparkling cider
Packing is 90% finding more tape
True. Want help one evening?
You'd do that?? Yes please
Gift idea: everyone chips in for the stand mixer she registered for?
Yes. Let's collect through PayPal so I can keep track. $30 each?
Perfect. I'll pass the word around
I'll send the requests tonight
Requests sent to everyone. Reminder: keep it a secret from L.
One person asked if she can pay cash at the shower
Fine. Cash goes in an envelope and I'll log it
I'm done at 6, coming over with takeout
Kitchen done. We're heroes. Pizza was elite
Shower was lovely!! Did you see her face when she opened the mixer
She cried, I cried, the cousin cried
I took 80 photos. Sending the best ones to the group
Bless you. My hair was in rebellion that day
You looked great! Thank you for the spreadsheet cleanup
Keys handed over. Officially homeless for 3 days till the new lease starts lol
Couch is open if you need it. Docket will supervise
Staying with my sister, thanks though! 💛
Hair trial is booked for the 12th, 10 AM at Salon Verde. Are you in?
Sorry, hardly had signal. Yes, 10 AM on the 12th, I'm in
Settled in!! Come see the new place when you can
Perfect. Are you at the dress fitting tomorrow? I'm at 11:00
9:30 with Lucia, so we'll overlap for a minute. I'll save you a seat
Coffee after?
Yes please. I need caffeine and a nap
Same. Should I bring safety pins and a sewing kit?
Yes! Always
Bring tape too, double-sided. Bless you
Podcast rec: the one about the cold case in Montana. I'm on episode 3 and furious
Added to the queue. Is it the same hosts as the lake one?
No, new ones. Less jokey. You'll like it
Rooftop thing tonight at Zoe's. You coming?
Can't, the Fourth is when I do absolutely nothing. Docket and I have a date with a lemon bar
Bex, are we doing matching shoes for the bridesmaids or nah?
Lucia said nude or champagne, our choice. I'm going champagne.
Champagne it is. I'll tell Marisol.
Group gift for the shower is about $20 each. I'll PayPal-request everyone tonight.
Perfect, send it over 💐
New yoga studio opened by the brewery. Free first class
I'm loyal to Ridgeline but... free is free
Just finished the true crime book you lent me. That ending! 😮
I KNOW. Don't spoil it for yourself by googling the case
Okay I need your opinion. Blue sofa or gray sofa. Be honest.
Blue. Gray is what people buy when they've given up.
Blue it is. You've made a hard decision easy.
How's the apartment hunt going?
Got the keys yesterday!! There's a tiny balcony and a neighbor who plays the cello 🎻
That's so cute. Cello neighbor is a plus.
Heels or flats for the rehearsal dinner?
Flats. The venue has gravel paths
Smart. You're always the practical one
Gravel + stilettos = disaster
Playlist for the drive down? I'm making one for the bridesmaids' car
Indie-folk obviously. I'll send you my favorites
Please, I need more than the same 5 songs
Sent you the playlist link
Housewarming soon. I'll make dumplings and you bring something sparkly to drink
Done. I'll grab something from the Co-op. Not the cheap stuff, I promise.
Do you still have the box of moving boxes from last year? Mine are all trash
They're flattened behind my bookshelf. Come take them, I'm tired of tripping on them.
Coming by tomorrow evening. I'll bring snacks as payment.
Snacks accepted. Docket will supervise.
Dinner soon? It's been weeks
No pressure. Just miss you
Yes. Things have been nuts. Let me look at my week and I'll text you
Got it. It's SO good, adding to the car queue
Yay
Did you see the new season trailer?
Yes!! I screamed
Watch party? My place
This weekend I'm slammed. The one after?
Fine. I'm making the dumplings
Okay I'm moving heaven and earth for dumplings
Knew it
Hot take: the lead is miscast
Rebecca no
Lol I'll argue it over dumplings
Dinner this week? Just us, no wedding talk
I'd love that. Maybe right after the wedding?
Fair. Put it on the calendar
Will do 💛
Love you, Bex
Rebecca, can you pull the Hargrove medical records index before 10? Ines wants it for the call.
On it. Will have it on your desk in 20.
Thanks. Also, courier's coming for the Alvarez exhibits at 1. Make sure the binders are tabbed.
Tabbed and indexed yesterday. Colored tabs for plaintiff exhibits, blue for defense.
Good. You're a lifesaver.
Heads up, I'll be at the courthouse till 11. Phone on silent.
Got it. I'll cover the front line and reschedule your 10:30.
Appreciate it. Order lunch for the team if I run over, firm card.
Will do. Sandwiches from the place on Lexington?
Perfect.
Rebecca - confirming court run to the county courthouse this afternoon. Filing stamp copies back by 4
Yes sir. Leaving at 1:15 with the packet
Team lunch is on the firm this week. Pick a place
Rosa's? Dana wants pizza
Quick one: the Whitlow deposition got moved up. Can you rebook the court reporter?
Already emailed them. Waiting for a confirmation. I'll flag you when it lands.
You're two steps ahead of me as usual.
Confirmed for 9 AM. Conference room B is booked and I put the exhibit list in the shared drive.
Great. Remind me to bring the reading glasses this time.
They're in the top drawer of your desk. Behind the stapler.
How do you know that
I'm a paralegal. It's my job to know where things are 😉
Running 15 late, start the client call without me
Will do. Notes to you after
Rebecca, the expert witness cancelled. Can you find backups?
Pulling the list now. I have three from the Raleigh pool and one from Charlotte.
Send me CVs by noon. Ines wants to interview them.
Sent to both of you. Highlighted the ones with trial experience.
Thank you. Staff lunch is on me tomorrow, you've earned it.
Running 10 minutes behind this morning, parking garage was full.
No problem. Ines is in a call till 9 anyway.
Good work on the settlement summary. Client was pleased
Thanks Dale. Ines helped a lot with the demand numbers
Need the Hutchins exhibit list by noon, if you can swing it
It'll be in your inbox by 11
Quarterly filing calendar is updated. I color-coded the deadlines by attorney.
Perfect. Can you also send me the clean list of open matters?
Attached to your email just now.
Got it. Thanks, Rebecca. Go home at a decent hour tonight.
Will try. Goodnight!
Heads up, firm picnic planning email going out soon. Bring a dessert if you're so inclined
Can't wait. I'll bring lemon bars
6:15 at the footbridge. Fast group is doing 8
I'll do the slow 5 with you, deal?
Deal. Bring water, it's already muggy
Great run today. Your pace is really coming back
My lungs hate you and thank you
Route change: the greenway is flooded near the park, meeting at the boat ramp
Got it. On my way
River run tomorrow? 6:30 at the boat ramp, 5 miles easy.
6:30 is brutal but fine. Bringing the headlamp.
Easy 5, I promise. Maybe 5.5.
Race sign ups open for the October 10K, interested?
Maybe. Entry fee is $55 though. Let me think
Late registration is $70. Think fast 😅
River run this weekend? Going to try the longer loop, 7 miles
7 is a lot. Can I walk the last mile and pretend it's a cooldown?
Deal. Cooldown walk counts.
Meet at the boat ramp at 7. I'll bring electrolyte tablets.
I'll bring bananas
Heads up, trail has a washout past the second bridge. Wear the older shoes.
Noted. My older shoes are basically held together by hope.
Ha. Hope runs fast.
Back at it soon, promise
Still on for the weekend after this one? There's a 5K at Carrier Park
Maybe. Ask me again when my legs forgive me.
Who has the key to the supply closet? I need toner and my soul
Ines has it. Lower drawer of her desk, left side
Did you see the email about the new e-filing portal? They want us to re-register
Saw it. I'll do it tomorrow morning before the 9:00 call
Lunch run? Taco truck is outside the courthouse
Can't. Stuck on exhibit stickers for the Kessler binder
Brought back a chicken one for you anyway, no arguments
You're a saint. I owe you $4
Do you have the Ortega exhibits tabbed yet? Ines is asking.
Tabbed and in the red folder on your desk. Index is in the shared drive.
You're a lifesaver. Coffee tomorrow, on me.
Dale is on the warpath about the Kessler deadline. Heads up
Already on it. Binder tabs done, just waiting on the medical records vendor
Did you see the new coffee machine in the break room? It has a touchscreen. I'm scared of it.
I pressed the wrong button and got hot chocolate. At 8 AM. I drank it anyway.
😂 Legend.
Are you doing the lunch order today? I want the chicken wrap
Yes. Chicken wrap, no onions. Got it.
You remember everything. It's actually creepy.
Lunch? The new taco truck is outside
Can't, working through. Bring me one?
Two al pastor or three?
Two. I'll pay you back tomorrow
Don't be silly, get me next time
Who left the break room coffee pot empty again 😤
Not me this time!
It was Dale. Of course it was Dale
I'll make a fresh pot
Coffee on me, you look wrecked. Bad night?
Just a lot on my mind. Coffee yes please
Ines was in a mood yesterday. Did you survive prep?
Barely. The privilege log was 140 entries
Ugh. Coffee on me tomorrow
Switchback at 8:15?
Deal. I'll even get you the oat milk thing
You're a saint
Printer on 2 is jammed again. Should I call IT or just kick it
Open the back tray, there's usually a crumpled page stuck behind the roller.
Fixed!! You're a wizard
Court run to the annex at 2. Want anything from the deli?
Turkey on rye, extra pickles 🙏
Did Dale approve the exhibit list?
Not yet, he's in with Ines
ok I'll hold the binder tabs
Can you print 4 copies of the index
sure, color or b/w
B/W, the color printer is jammed
It's always jammed lol
I'm out tomorrow morning btw, dress fitting. Back by 1
Noted, I'll cover phones
Bring donuts and I'll forgive the printer
Happy hour at the brewery after work tomorrow? Just a quick one
Can't, I have plans tonight. Rain check?
Always a rain check with you lol. Okay, next week.
Next week for sure. First round's on me.
Holding you to it 🍺
Did you survive the e-filing outage this morning
Barely. Had to hand-carry a motion to the courthouse at 11:50
I saw the counter line from the parking deck, it was a nightmare
I got stuck behind a man paying a traffic fine in quarters
lol every time
Lunch this week? Thai place?
Thai place is closed for renovations. Burrito place on Biltmore?
Yes
Serious question, would you ever leave Brannock Shaw
Not today. Dale is annoying but fair and Ines is brilliant
My firm just posted a litigation paralegal role. 7k more
Seven thousand?? Don't tempt me
Think about it. The hours are worse tho
There it is
Recommend a good true crime podcast with actual research, not just vibes
Anything with a lawyer or journalist on the hosts. I'll send you three
Sent them. The one about the wrongful conviction is my favorite
Trivia night at the brewery, our team needs a fourth. In?
Which brewery
The one with the dog that sits on the stage
Obviously in
We came in third. Lost on a question about Roman emperors
I will never recover from the lighthouse question
That wasn't even fair
Is it weird that I'm learning legal terms from your recommendations and now bore my coworkers?
Great. Join us.
Reminder you owe me a book. Return the mystery I lent you
Which one, the one with the lighthouse?
lol no, the one with the sister in the cellar
Oh no. I'm on the last chapter, I'll return it end of next week
Take your time. But don't tell me the ending
Never. The butler did it. Kidding
I will unfriend you
Coffee at Switchback? I'm there now
Ten minutes. Order me the oat latte
Coffee is on me today. You can get the next
Have you listened to the episode on the Hollis case yet?
Not yet, I'm saving it for my run
It's wild. They found the key in a flower pot
STOP spoiling
I said nothing!!
Heard the firm is slammed. Remember to breathe
Trivia night is back at the brewery. Our team is still unbeaten at being worst
I'm in, if I can stay awake past 9
Lunch tomorrow? I have news
Ooh. Tomorrow's crammed, Ines has a filing deadline at 4. Quick lunch at 12:15?
12:15 burrito place. Be there
Okay so I accepted the other job lol. Start in three weeks
Lena!! Congratulations!! That's huge
Scary huge. Will you still be my trivia fourth
Always. Drinks to celebrate soon, my treat once payday hits
Hey! Are you doing the 6 PM flow tonight? I'll save you a spot by the window
Yes please, I need it. My shoulders are up by my ears.
Say less. Bring the blocks, the studio ones are all cracked.
That class destroyed me in the best way
Right?? Pigeon pose is a spiritual experience
I have a podcast rec for you. True crime but it's two sisters who are both lawyers. Very you.
Send the name. I'm always hungry for a new one.
'Cross Examined.' Start with the one about the missing ledger
Downloading now 🎧
Did you get the thing about the neighborhood yard sale? I'm doing a table
Saw it! I have a box of books and one ugly lamp
Okay I listened to two episodes on my run. Gripping. Why are lawyers so funny
Because we cope through humor 😂 (I'm not a lawyer but I'm adopting them)
Heat advisory today. Cancel the run
Already did a 6 AM run, cooler by the river
Studio's doing a sunrise class at the farmers market lot. Want to go?
What time is sunrise these days, 5:45? I'm in, but I'll be a zombie.
Zombie yoga is the best yoga
Okay that was gorgeous. Mist on the mountains and a golden retriever photobombed savasana
Best savasana of my life. I want that dog's life.
Do you still have that recipe for the lentil soup?
Sending it. Add extra lemon, trust me
Do you have a spare mat? My friend is visiting and wants to try a class
I have a spare in the car. I'll drop it at the studio front desk tomorrow
You're the best, seriously
Left the mat at the front desk. It's the purple one with the coffee stain, sorry.
Got it, character building 😂
My landlord is raising rent again. Do not move out of West Asheville, I need neighbors
Walt hasn't said anything about an increase to me. Knocking on wood
Heads up, the studio's raising class prices by $2 next month
